title: Betting odds favorite accuracy
intro: The betting favorite won 66.3% of 1,420 games in 2021–2025, and 67.6% of 136 games so far in 2026 (65.8% in 2025).
note: These figures use closing-line moneylines from nflverse schedules, with the bookmaker's cut removed. Ties are excluded. The pick a few days before kickoff can differ slightly from the close.

model_accuracy.source_label: Our stats model (team stats only, no betting lines)
model_accuracy.title: Betting odds favorite accuracy
model_accuracy.intro: Picked the winner 61.4% of the time on 2023–25 (n=854), below the betting favorite's 68.1%. Shown at Gilbert's request; not a betting signal.
